text: player
Hi there!
While searching for my "targets" in the amusement park, I suddenly spot Qi Xi reading while walking in front of me.
Qi Xi
Ahhh! How dare you sneak up on me! Are you trying to scare me to death?!
After I pat him on the back, Qi Xi grumbles as he picks up the book he was reading called "Dating Spots You Must Visit."
Don't tell me some of these dating spots are in this amusement park.
Only most of them.
...Is that you, {var:player_nickname}?
Upon hearing my name, I look over and see Nanaha Onodera walking toward me from the other side of the intersection with a notebook and a pen in her hands. Suddenly, an idea comes to mind...
What a great coincidence. Can you two help me with something?
What do you have in mind?
Nanaha Onodera
Yeah, what do you need us for? I'm on my way to my place of inspiration, you know...
I scratch my head as I gather my thoughts.

Okay, so here's the thing... I was strolling around when I bumped into a friend who is the editor-in-chief of a magazine. Seeing her hard at work on her laptop even at the amusement park made me feel sorry for her, so I bought her an iced coffee to cheer her up.
Isn't that normal?
After that, she managed to persuade me to help her interview people...
Chihori Terasaki
Don't worry, this interview is pretty easy. You just need to ask people what ride they think is most effective in making couples closer. It shouldn't take you long since you're so popular.
Several minutes ago
Chihori Terasaki pats my shoulder expectantly and looks at me like she's saying: "I have faith in you."
Let's meet up here again later. I'll call you then. I can't wait to see your results.
Wait up, Chihori!
However, the only response I get is a gust of wind... and the sound of a voice fading in the wind.
Oh right, thanks for the coffee—

In short, I need to find rides that create a romantic atmosphere and interview tourists about what they think. One of you is in charge of love and romance, and the other has researched love extensively. Since I've bumped into you here, can you give me some advice?
Well, I was just thinking about checking if the book is right about the Ferris wheel having the most romantic vibe. I suppose I can consider taking you with me.
...I'm on my way to the log flume. I've read about it many times in novels and want to take this chance to experience it personally... You... can also join me.
I see...
It looks like I can't have my cake and eat it since I can't go to the Ferris wheel and the log flume at the same time.
Go to the Ferris wheel with Qi Xi.
Go to the log flume with Nanaha Onodera.
From what I hear, the Ferris wheel is the most popular ride among lovers, so it's reasonable to check it out first.
I've decided. I'll experience the Ferris wheel. Onodera, will you come with us?
Hmm... a Ferris wheel of love involving three people... doesn't sound appropriate at all... Thanks, but I'm going to my place of inspiration.
Huh?
She seems to have imagined something weird...
Qi Xi and I arrive at the Ferris wheel to find it filled with couples. As a lot of people are looking at us, I quickly pull Qi Xi into the red cabin closest to us.
Hmph! That goes without saying... Huh? Look over there!
Hmm?
After our Ferris wheel cabin rises to a certain height, Qi Xi leans against the glass and looks out excitedly, making an expression typical of a little boy of his age.
Haha! The people on the roller coaster look like they've been scared out of their wits!
I can't see them, but I can hear their screams.
Haha! Look at that balloon that's rising higher and higher into the air! Where did it come from?
I get the feeling that there's one more sad child at the amusement park today.
Hahahaha... Why are those tourists all making the same pose for photos?
About that... humans are surprisingly like-minded when it comes to the poses they make in scenic areas.
Why does it seem like you're just looking for something to laugh at?
What's fun about being locked up in this little room if I don't entertain myself like this? It doesn't move that high or quickly and isn't as fun as a roller coaster.
Look over there.
Qi Xi looks where I'm pointing and sees a couple snuggling together and whispering in the cabin below us through the glass.
Oh, their fingertips are tied together by a red thread. They have been brought together by fate.

I look at Qi Xi in surprise. I guess he isn't the God of Love for nothing since he can tell that with just one glance. Suddenly, I see the couple lean against each other lovingly, and their heads are getting closer and closer...
...Huh?
I cover Qi Xi's eyes in the nick of time.
Ahem, someone your age shouldn't be watching this.
I'm not really this young! {var:Shake}

Qi Xi pries my fingers apart and presses himself against the glass again to see what's happening in the other cabins... Suddenly, he blushes and retreats back to his seat in a panic where he remains motionless like a statue.
So even the God of Love feels embarrassed when seeing other people acting intimately. To ease his embarrassment, I quickly motion for him to look in another direction.
Just ignore them. Come and watch the scenery with me. The scenery looks so stunning from this height.
N-No, I've already seen enough! You watch it yourself!
But the Ferris wheel is not even halfway finished... Are you just going to sit there for the rest of the ride?
Mortals should stay out of the business of the God of Love!
The closed-off, isolated, and soundproof Ferris wheel is only halfway through, yet the stubborn and flustered expression on Qi Xi's face tells me that he would already be gone if he could...
When the Ferris wheel finally ends, Qi Xi pulls me and starts running away frantically through the many pairs of lovers the moment the door opens.
From a distance, I see Nanaha Onodera standing near the exit of the ride with water dripping from the ends of her hair.
Huh? I didn't realize the exits of the two rides were this close...
Look at how wet your hair is. The log flume sure is an intense ride...
Well, it's a source of inspiration to me... Here, this might come in handy.
What's this?
Nanaha Onodera hands me a piece of paper.
I got some inspiration... so I wrote some ideas about love, water, summer... and an amusement park...
"With her hair dripping with water, she hid shyly in her lover's arms. Her wet clothes clung to her skin and soaked into her lover's embrace..."
...And I'll stop right there. Thanks, it's very well written!
The material Nanaha Onodera gave me might not be suitable for Chihori Terasaki's entertainment magazine which targets people of all ages...
Ahem! What now? Is experiencing one ride enough for your interview?
I think I'll need to experience a few more rides.
I still have some time today, so I can accompany you... let's check out the other dating spots mentioned in the book.

I'm not sure about the other rides, but the log flume is something that really must be experienced here during the summer. Just the thought of rushing down a slide through huge, cool towering waves from a high place on a motorboat makes me excited.
I think I want to experience the log flume. Qi Xi, will you come with me?
No. That ride isn't one of the dating spots recommended by you humans, which means you humans don't approve of it either.
I'm busy, so I won't be joining you.
Whee! This ride is simply the best on a hot day... Oh, thank you.
That's how my log flume experience ended.
In the rest area near the exit, the staff hands us soft, dry towels so we can wipe ourselves dry after finishing the ride.
As water gun platforms are set up near the bottom of the slide for tourists on the shore to squirt players sliding down the river, half of our bodies are soaked by the time we finish the ride.
Onodera, are you okay?
Well... I'm completely drenched, but...

Nanaha Onodera lowers her head and wipes her hair dry with a towel while sitting on a chair. Her wet stockings and shoes are placed neatly to one side and probably won't be dry any time soon. She seems to be in a good mood though, because she is smiling.
But... when embarrassing things happen at the right time... it's often the best catalyst for love.
Hmm?
Well... when beads of sweat run down your neck after exercising... when water droplets roll down your hair after a bath... or when you get soaked by heavy rain on a summer night...
Don't you think these embarrassing moments make people look absolutely adorable to their lover?
In a classic romance novel... these moments are when one of them tries to wipe the hair of the other person, instantly raising the romantic tension...
Y-You have a point...
The remaining water in Nanaha Onodera's hair drips down, wetting the hem of her skirt that had just dried slightly. After noticing an unused, dry towel nearby, I walk over and ask her a question.
Do you need me to dry your hair for you?
Yes, that would be great.
I grab the dry towel and wipe Nanaha Onodera's hair carefully. While I wipe her hair, I can sense the moisture from her hair in my palms.
...Don't be nervous. This pressure is just right, and you won't hurt my hair.
O-Oh... okay.
Although that's what she said, I continue to wipe her hair carefully. With her back facing me, she seems to be thinking about something as she has stopped talking.
In the silence, I suddenly remember what she said earlier about rising romantic tension... Could this be happening to us right now?
Male Tourist
Hahaha! Look at your face! Hahahaha! Your makeup is a complete mess. I'm going to take a photo of you right now!
Female Tourist
H-How dare you even think of taking a photo... Die!!!
It looks like the other tourists behind us are starting to come out after finishing the ride.
Child
Mommy! Can I go on the ride again? Just one more time! Please!
Tourist A
Whoa! Where's my identity card? No way! I didn't drop it, did I?!!!
Tourist B
Hey, since you're here, does that mean you've finished your homework already? Huh? You haven't written a single word? Hahaha, bro, same here!
I don't know if the vibe that was building up involved any rising romantic tension or not, but it dissipates instantly.
When we reach the exit after finishing the log flume, we bump into Qi Xi.
Oh! I never realized the exits of the two rides were in the same place.
How did it go?
It was okay. I got to see flustered humans in the entire amusement park, which isn't bad at all.
For some reason, I get the feeling that Qi Xi has the wrong idea about the ride.
But... there are some other spots I need to check out. Hey! Is experiencing one ride enough for your interview?
I don't think so. What should I try next...
Why don't you try the one behind you?
...This place is an... escape room?
A dark room and the desire to protect another person... Hmm.
Qi Xi flips through the book in his hand quickly.
This is also one of the places I was thinking of checking out.
Let's go there then.
Ahhhhhhh! {var:ShakeScene}
In the dark escape room, the three of us are so scared that we hide in a corner and scream.
Were you two serious when you recommended this place? Is such a scary escape room really suitable for a date?!
Y-You don't understand! Th-This is just the vibe we need. You need a dangerous and scary situation to see what your lover is really like! Wait here while I lead those ghosts away!
After saying that, Qi Xi rushes out with his hands on his hips, shouting as he runs toward the end of the corridor.
Hey! Come and chase me! I bet you can't catch me!
Q-Qi Xi...
You don't need to worry about me. The book says this is what a man should do when they are in love!
I'm trying to tell you that you're shouting in the wrong direction. The ghosts are behind you!
AHHHHHHH!!! {var:ShakeScene}
The chaotic sounds of "fighting" outside gradually fade into the distance. After observing the surroundings for a while, I give Nanaha Onodera next to me a pat.
Let's go while the ghosts are after Qi Xi. This is our best chance to find the items we need to escape.
Alright.
There are lots of obstacles on the ground, so be careful when you walk.
Ah!
Huh? Are you okay?
...Hehe, this is an interesting experience.
What? How is falling down interesting? Don't let your imagination run wild at a time like this.
No, I'm talking about how darkness amplifies the senses. The beating of your heart and your breathing is crystal clear to me... You're feeling nervous right now.
R-Really?
Well, sometimes it's easier to sense each other more clearly when you can't actually see each other... This form of unusual intimate contact is especially important for lovers.
...So that's what you had in mind when you recommended this place to me.

It turns out that Nanaha Onodera and Qi Xi have completely different ideas about what makes an escape room fun... However, from this perspective, I have to admit that this place is perfect for fostering love and intimacy.
Oh... I see...
...Onodera?
Onodera suddenly leans against me while I'm thinking, filling my nose with the sweet fragrance from her body.
Stop... I know what you mean... You don't need to show me...
I've found it.
Huh?
The item we need to escape is behind you.
You guys are too slow! The ghost almost got me!
Thanks! We wouldn't be able to get out so quickly if it wasn't for you.
I-It was nothing. I just used a tiny bit of my power.
While chatting with them, I flip through my notebook filled with reviews. I wonder if I have enough information to complete Chihori Terasaki's request.
{var:player_nickname}.
Chihori?
Speak of the devil. I look up and see her in front of me.
I happened to see you here when I was sorting the reviews for other topics, so I thought I would check up on your progress.
Everything is going well. I managed to gain a lot of experience and insight with the help of my two friends here.
Really? Then I asked the right person for help. As thanks, let me treat you to a meal after I finish what I'm doing.
You still have work to do?
Yes, I asked you to take care of this topic, but there's still another review that needs to be done.
I see. I guess practice makes perfect. What's the other theme? You'll be able to finish sooner if I help you.
Oh? That would be great. The other topic is "amusement park of horror."
Um... amusement park of... what?
I have other spots to check out, so I'm not going to join you for this...
Sorry... leave me out of this horror novel.
Huh?
They left so fast. I guess I can only treat them to a meal next time. {var:player_nickname}, follow me then since you're so enthusiastic.
Wait... Stop! I've already been in this escape room once. I don't need to go inside again... Help! {var:ShakeScene}
Sigh... it's only been a few days since I saw you. When will you stop making people worry about you?

According to the book called "99 Fail-Proof Secret Ways to Confess Your Love," it's best to confess one's love in a place that is romantic, secluded, private, and feels special... This place looks like a great place for romantic feelings to grow.
It looks like the Ferris wheel is the most ideal dating spot. You're really professional, God of Love.
Ahhhhhhh! {var:Shake}
Half an hour later...
Ahhhhhhh!{var:Shake}
Nanaha Onodera falls while I'm speaking, and I rush over to help her up. Her breathing is a little flustered, but she smiles at me.
I don't feel like I can get angry at you now that you're suddenly being so polite to me...
